::: {#rem-deviance-shift}

#### Why the shift does not change the drop in deviance

The constant $2 \satllik$ in @cor-deviance-shift is the same for every model fit to the same data, because the saturated model depends only on the data.
So the difference between the deviances of two models, such as the drop in deviance of @thm-deviance-drop, is the same whether it is computed from $\deviance$ or from $\satdeviance$.
The two deviances differ in their size, though: when every pattern has one replicate, the saturated model fits every label exactly, $\satllik = 0$, and $\satdeviance = \deviance$.

:::
